description: Dependency cadence: look weekly (Monday 06:00-11:00 UTC), skip releases younger than 3 days, and automerge once every check on the PR is green. Renovate's own automerge waits for ALL checks, including the path-triggered build-verify job that must gate Hugo bumps; GitHub's platform auto-merge only waits for required status checks, and none are configured, so platformAutomerge stays off. A red job leaves the PR open for a human.

customManagers.description: Hugo version mirrored into netlify.toml for Netlify's own Hugo build (all three contexts). Same depName as the mise.toml hugo-extended manager below, so Renovate updates both files in one PR.

Hugo pin in mise.toml. The native mise manager cannot update hugo-extended: it resolves through the aqua backend to the nested package name gohugoio/hugo/hugo-extended, which is not a GitHub repo. This regex manager claims the line with the same depName as netlify.toml, so the Hugo group updates mise.toml and netlify.toml together.
The mise CLI pinned in every workflow's mise-action step. CI and dev machines agree on the installer build; one PR bumps all occurrences.

packageRules.description: Group all Hugo version updates (mise.toml + netlify.toml) into one PR

@lhci/cli frozen at 0.15.1: 0.16.0 fails mise's aube supply-chain check (its chromium-bidi dependency lost trusted-publisher evidence), and no CI job installs lhci, so an automerged bump would go green while breaking every local mise install. Drop this rule when upstream trust evidence is restored.
Keep the native mise manager away from hugo-extended; its extraction cannot resolve a working lookup (nested aqua package). The regex manager above owns that line.

No release-asset digests on the mise CLI pin: the value feeds mise-action's `version:` input, which cannot parse a `#digest` suffix, and pinDigests would otherwise try. Version-only updates are what we want.
Group the mise-pinned developer tooling into one PR. mise deps carry short names (shfmt, vale, npm:@lhci/cli); the owner/repo entries keep matching via packageName.
Node from mise: minor/patch ride with the tooling group
Node majors are a manual decision: mjml and @lhci/cli run on it, and a major can change both at once
MJML minor/patch join the tooling group; majors stay separate
MJML majors are breaking (v5 is a rewrite the templates were ported to at the time): no automerge, human takes them with a full make email-validate pass
